title: Regional availability SLA
statement: The system shall achieve at least 99.99% monthly availability for a regional deployment spanning 3 availability zones.
rationale: Research default aligned with Spanner regional SLA structure.

acceptance_criteria.text: Availability is measured per calendar month as the fraction of 1-minute intervals in which a synthetic probe's read and write both succeed, and is ≥ 99.99%.
Loss of one full availability zone causes no interval of unavailability longer than the failover bound.
